metadata.title: Conference Bridges

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for hosting and mediating real-time audio and video conferencing sessions.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Audio/video conferencing platforms, virtual meeting services, and real-time media bridges.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Pattern for controlled, accountable, and secure real-time conferencing across trusted and federated participants.

props.name: data-entity
props.remarks: Conference sessions, participant rosters, media streams, chat backchannels, recordings, transcripts, and meeting audit metadata.

props.name: depends-on-pattern
props.remarks: Conference Bridges inherit baseline collaboration trust, identity context, boundary control, and accountability guarantees from Collaboration Core.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Conference bridges align with NIST SP 800-58 guidance for securing VoIP and video over IP signaling, media transport, and session control.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Conference participants frequently join from remote and unmanaged environments, requiring controls consistent with SP 800-46.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: External and federated conferencing scenarios must define trust boundaries and responsibilities in accordance with SP 800-47.

metadata.remarks: Conference Bridges define real-time audio and video collaboration capabilities involving transient but highly sensitive trust relationships. This pattern governs participant admission, session control, media protection, and recording accountability while relying on Collaboration Core for baseline identity, boundary, and lifecycle guarantees.

components.title: Participant Admission and Identity Verification
components.description: Controls how participants join conferencing sessions and ensures identities are accurately represented.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Use of valid accounts or meeting links to gain unauthorized access to conference sessions.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Masquerading via misleading display names or suppressed identity indicators during meetings.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Strong identity binding and admission controls mitigate unauthorized or misleading participation.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Conference participants are authenticated and attributable.
Enforcement mechanisms restrict unauthorized session entry.

components.title: Session Boundary and Control
components.description: Provides mechanisms to manage participant roles, mute states, screen sharing, and session lifecycle.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Abuse of trusted session roles to disrupt meetings or observe sensitive content.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Role-based session controls limit participant capabilities and reduce misuse.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Conference roles and privileges are explicitly managed.
Least privilege is applied to participant capabilities.

components.title: Media Protection and Confidentiality
components.description: Protects audio, video, and shared media streams against interception or manipulation.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Eavesdropping on unprotected real-time media streams.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Encrypted media transport protects conference audio and video confidentiality.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Cryptographic mechanisms protect real-time media confidentiality.
Transmission confidentiality and integrity are enforced for conference media.

components.title: Recording, Transcription, and Accountability
components.description: Governs if, when, and how conference sessions are recorded, stored, accessed, and audited.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Collection of information through unauthorized access to recorded sessions or transcripts.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Deletion or suppression of evidence related to meeting recordings.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Audit logging and controlled access to recordings support accountability and investigation.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Conference recordings and access events are logged.
Recorded media is protected against unauthorized access or distribution.
